items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1961-08-15
items.q: I played with the Eureka band, I played with old man Allie's band. And that was brass band.

ctx.x: Professor Delmore, yeah. I take one lesson from him. I only wanted to learn the fundamental part of it, because I know the music myself. That is, I wanted to learn the fingering and the different and the treble clef and the bass clef. Because I figured on my new music and I could do it on and learn it myself. I didn't need to take no lesson on it. I had been taking enough lessons on the clarinet and the trumpet. I took lessons on clarinet and trumpet, I never did take that on the sax, I never did take but the one…
Now, I played and- Excuse me, did you ever play string bass at any time in your life? No, I just waited until I got old as I am now to start taking it up.
